Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.utils.system

Class UserService

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.utils.system.UserService
public final class UserService extends Object
Reads local users and groups and performs user administration.

Reading is done directly from /etc/passwd and /etc/group (no privileges needed). All mutations (add/remove user, set password, change groups) go through PrivilegedRunner (pkexec), which returns a structured result so the control center can prompt for authorization, report a dismissal, or switch to read-only when polkit is unavailable.

No JNI/JNA; pure JDK plus the standard useradd/usermod/ userdel/groupadd/gpasswd/chpasswd tools.
